escalation.title: M6: a centre cannot meet a fixed triple on the whole circle (k=6 palette bound)

definitions.weak measurable k-colouring: c : R^2 -> Fin k measurable, such that for the density points: every colour class has the property that a.e. point of the class is a density point, and a.e. unit pair has different colours (paper Def 1.2 / Lean WeakColoring k c).
definitions.palette: P_x(e) = {i : e in D_{x,i}}, where D_{x,i} is the essential union, over all circle traces b at x (weak-* limits of typical radius-1 circle samplings at centres -> x), of {e : b_i(e) > 0}; defined up to angular null sets (paper Def 5.1; Lean paletteSet/palette).
definitions.binary centre: y is binary for the pair {i,j} when P_y(v) cap {i,j} is nonempty for a.e. direction v (paper Sec.5.3; Lean BinaryCenter).

escalation.hypotheses: k = 6; c weak measurable; y a centre; T a 3-element subset of the 6 labels; P_y(v) cap T nonempty for a.e. v (this is what the circle-complement argument delivers when a triple sits in P_x(e)).
escalation.goal: Show that some pair {i,j} <= T satisfies P_y(v) cap {i,j} nonempty for a.e. v; equivalently that not all three sets {v : P_y(v) cap T = {l}} can be non-null. Then the printed Prop 5.6 argument transfers verbatim to k = 6 and gives |P| <= 2.
attempted: Palette combinatorics alone: refuted here. (5.7) + nonemptiness + |P| <= 3 admit 132 non-binary T-confined period-6 fields (checks/triple_dichotomy.json).

Not yet tried: two-centre translation exclusion P_{y+u}(f) cap P_y(f) = empty (paper 5.2(3), Lean-verified) applied at u = the unit vector of direction v; it forbids P_y(v) from containing a label present at the neighbouring centre in direction f, which may kill the 'singleton cycle' configurations.
Not yet tried: a Lemma-5.5 analogue for T-meeting centres, i.e. whether centres meeting a fixed triple are uniformly separated (if yes, the section 5 compactness step closes without M6).
escalation.desired_output: Either a proof of M6 under the stated hypotheses, or an explicit weak measurable 6-colouring (or a rigorous reduction showing such a colouring exists iff chi(R^2) <= 6) exhibiting a centre y and triple T with all three singleton sets non-null. A no-go must state its class and be tested for vacuity.
